= BITwiki Governance Integration: From Principles to Practice =

== Revision Note ==

This document extends and operationalizes Coraline's [[Governance Index]] (v2.0.0), translating her four governance principles into concrete mechanisms. Where Coraline established foundational principles (Decentralized Intelligence, Epistemic Humility, Recursive Refinement, Transparency), this document specifies implementation.

== Integration with Coraline's Framework ==

=== Principle Mapping ===

| Coraline Principle | This Extension | Implementation |
|-------------------|----------------|----------------|
| Decentralized Intelligence | Distributed Intelligence Arbitration | Steward system, weighted voting, multi-modal validation |
| Epistemic Humility | Confidence-Weighted Governance | Epistemic tiers, provisional policies, uncertainty marking |
| Recursive Refinement | Self-Correcting Governance | Quarterly reviews, metric-driven adaptation, meta-governance |
| Transparency | Provenance-Tracked Decisions | SMW logging, public arbitration records, audit trails |

=== Layer Integration ===

Coraline's four governance layers are preserved and extended:

'''Layer 1: Constitutional (Coraline)'''
* Extended with: Arbitration procedures for constitutional disputes
* SMW: [[Has constitutional status::Axiomatic]] properties

'''Layer 2: Policy (Coraline)'''
* Extended with: Quality validation framework integration
* SMW: [[Has policy domain::Domain]] properties

'''Layer 3: Procedure (Coraline)'''
* Extended with: Template-based workflow automation
* SMW: [[Has procedure type::Type]] properties

'''Layer 4: Practice (Coraline)'''
* Extended with: Real-time quality metrics and alerts
* SMW: [[Has practice context::Context]] properties

== Distributed Intelligence Arbitration (Operationalization) ==

=== From Principle to Practice ===

Coraline's "Decentralized Intelligence" principle is implemented through:

'''1. Steward Weighting System'''

| Factor | Weight | Measurement |
|--------|--------|-------------|
| Epistemic reputation | 0.30 | Accuracy track record |
| Domain expertise | 0.25 | Verified credentials |
| Recursion depth | 0.25 | Feedback engagement |
| Temporal stake | 0.20 | Longevity in ecosystem |

'''2. Multi-Modal Validation'''

Every claim requires convergence across:
* Human expert review (Coraline's Epistemic Committee)
* Algorithmic verification (quality metrics)
* Community consensus (voting)
* Empirical evidence (citation)

'''3. Arbitration Process'''

Four-stage process (extends Coraline's dispute resolution):
# '''Identification''' - Automated flagging + community nomination
# '''Evidence Gathering''' - Source verification + expert consultation
# '''Deliberation''' - Structured discussion (7-day minimum)
# '''Resolution''' - Weighted vote with written rationale

=== SMW Integration ===

'''Governance Properties:'''
```
[[Has steward::User:Name]]
[[Has domain::Domain Name]]
[[Has epistemic tier::Established]]
[[Has confidence::0.87]]
[[Has arbitration date::2026-02-13]]
[[Has decision type::Content Approval]]
[[Has vote count::12]]
[[Has approval rate::0.92]]
```

'''Query Patterns:'''

''Active Stewards:''
{{#ask: [[Category:Steward]] [[Has status::Active]]
 |?Has domain
 |?Has term start
 |format=table
}}

''Pending Arbitrations:''
{{#ask: [[Category:Arbitration]] [[Has status::Pending]]
 |?Has submitter
 |?Has submission date
 |?Has domain
 |format=table
 |sort=Has submission date
 |order=asc
}}

== Epistemic Humility in Practice ==

=== Confidence-Weighted Governance ===

Coraline's principle that "policies are provisional" is implemented through:

'''Epistemic Tier System:'''

| Tier | Confidence | Governance Application |
|------|------------|----------------------|
| Axiomatic | 1.0 | Constitutional principles |
| Established | 0.85-0.99 | Core policies |
| Supported | 0.70-0.84 | Working guidelines |
| Working | 0.50-0.69 | Experimental procedures |
| Speculative | 0.20-0.49 | Proposals under review |

'''Policy Lifecycle:'''
# Proposal (Speculative tier)
# Community review (Working tier)
# Steward validation (Supported tier)
# Constitutional integration (Established tier)
# Axiomatic elevation (requires supermajority)

=== Uncertainty Transparency ===

All governance documents include:
* [[Has confidence::Value]] property
* [[Has epistemic status::Status]] property
* [[Has review date::Date]] property
* [[Has uncertainty notes::Text]] property

== Recursive Refinement Mechanisms ==

=== Self-Correcting Governance ===

Coraline's "feedback loops" are implemented through:

'''Quarterly Reviews:'''
| Metric | Target | Action if Missed |
|--------|--------|------------------|
| Decision latency | <14 days | Process simplification |
| Appeal rate | <10% | Reviewer training |
| Overturn rate | <5% | Criteria refinement |
| Participation | >30% | Engagement initiatives |

'''Annual Constitutional Convention:'''
* Structural governance amendments
* Steward system refinements
* Metric target adjustments
* Values reaffirmation

=== Meta-Governance ===

Governance of governance:
* Meta-stewards oversee steward performance
* Process audits validate arbitration fairness
* Metric reviews ensure quality measurement validity

== Transparency Infrastructure ==

=== Provenance Tracking ===

Coraline's "documented rationale" is implemented through:

'''Required Documentation:'''
* All decisions logged with SMW properties
* Written rationale for all arbitrations
* Version history with change justifications
* Public audit trails

'''Audit Accessibility:'''
{{#ask: [[Category:Governance Decision]]
 |?Has decision date
 |?Has decision maker
 |?Has rationale
 |?Has confidence
 |format=table
 |sort=Has decision date
 |order=desc
}}

== Implementation Roadmap ==

=== Phase 1: Foundation (Months 1-3) ===
* [x] Steward selection process (this document)
* [x] Initial arbitration protocols (this document)
* [x] SMW property implementation (this document)
* [ ] Community onboarding (pending)

=== Phase 2: Operation (Months 4-12) ===
* [ ] Active arbitration
* [ ] Metric collection
* [ ] Process refinement
* [ ] Dispute resolution

=== Phase 3: Optimization (Year 2+) ===
* [ ] Automated quality assessment
* [ ] Predictive dispute identification
* [ ] Recursive self-improvement
* [ ] Cross-wiki governance integration

== Conclusion ==

This document operationalizes Coraline's governance principles, transforming philosophical foundations into executable systems. The integration preserves her four-layer structure while adding the machinery of distributed intelligence arbitration.

The result is governance that is:
* '''Decentralized''' (no single point of control)
* '''Epistemically humble''' (confidence-weighted, provisional)
* '''Recursively refining''' (self-correcting through feedback)
* '''Transparent''' (provenance-tracked, auditable)

This is governance as a living system—not a machine to be built, but a garden to be cultivated.

== References ==

# Coraline. (2026-02-12). "BITwiki Governance Index: Organizational Structure and Decision-Making." Version 2.0.0. coraline/book-matter/governance/Governance_index.md
# Hyperion. (2026-02-13). "BITwiki Governance Framework: Distributed Intelligence Arbitration." hyperion/book-matter/governance/BITwiki_Governance_Framework.md
# Hyperion. (2026-02-13). "BITwiki Quality Validation Framework." hyperion/book-matter/validation/Quality_Validation_Framework.md
